observations: A single solar panel is shown leaning against a wall.
The panel has a silver frame and dark cells, likely monocrystalline.
There are 6 columns of cells visible.
Other similar panels are visible in the background.
A watermark 'SOBOBO LUMINARIES' is overlaid on the image.
No manufacturer label, logo, or technical specifications are visible on the front of the panel.

claims.evidence: The wattage is not visible on the panel; a photo of the rear specification label is required.
No brand logo or name is visible in photo 0.

risks.risk: The actual power output (wattage) may be significantly lower than claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the technical data label on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may be a generic or lesser brand rather than Canadian Solar.
risks.proof: A photo showing the manufacturer's logo or the brand name on the rear label.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded generic panel

risks.risk: Internal cell damage or micro-cracks that reduce efficiency.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) and Short Circuit Current (Isc) in direct sunlight.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with assumed degradation

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's specification label on the back of the panel.
Close-up photo of any brand logo on the frame or glass.
Video showing a multimeter test of the panel's output in bright sunlight.
response.reason: The value of a solar panel depends entirely on its verified wattage and brand. Without a photo of the specification label on the back, the seller's claims cannot be confirmed.
